## **Meta Ads Strategy**

  

Oct 7, 2026

[Dustin Baker](mailto:dustin@hiddengem.media) [Shawal Nazir](mailto:shawal@hiddengem.media) [Gillian Conley](mailto:gillian@hiddengem.media)

  

Competitive analysis covered marketing attribution and offer restructuring for property bookings.

  

## **Meta Ad Attribution Strategy and Client Offers**

  - Dustin noted that Sojourn operates a resort marketing model charging an 18% commission on completed direct bookings with zero upfront costs.
  - Improving attribution confidence enables offering stronger guarantees, such as doubling client investments or removing upfront fees.
  - Slightly over-attributing ad-driven bookings remains acceptable because clients prioritize overall performance over granular tracking audits.
  - Dustin outlined 4 core meta ad campaigns, including giveaway ads, retargeting lead ads, retargeting visitor purchase ads, and top-of-funnel purchase campaigns.

  

## **Technical Attribution and EMQ Improvements**

  - Leshan developed a custom script and plugin solution to capture click IDs and send reservation notes to Hinge AI for deduplication.
  - Northstar, Asheville, and Glass Homes utilize Cloudbeds as their PMS platform.
  - Dustin highlighted that raising EMQ from 5 to 7 or 9 significantly accelerates meta ad campaign optimization and performance.
  - Certain platforms like Logify may lack native API access required for Hinge AI integration.

  

## **Next steps**

  - \[Leshan, Shawal\] Sync attribution testing: Meet to discuss the deployment and testing of improved meta ad attribution for clients such as Asheville and Northstar.
  - \[Leshan\] Implement attribution method: Apply the custom plugin and script attribution solution across all supported Property Management Systems.
  - \[Leshan\] Request API access: Inquire about API access for Property Management Systems such as Logify to enable integration with Hinge AI.

## **Meta Ads Strategy**

Invited [Dustin Baker](mailto:dustin@hiddengem.media) [Shawal Nazir](mailto:shawal@hiddengem.media) [Gillian Conley](mailto:gillian@hiddengem.media)

Attachments [Meta Ads Strategy](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/event?eid=NTFqM3A4ZmNwa2o1dTNwN3J0NzFlYzJiZzVfMjAyNjEwMDdUMTcwMDAwWiBkdXN0aW5AaGlkZGVuZ2VtLm1lZGlh)

Meeting records [Transcript](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IDTNY2oBzIjvFxP9T_oKb_YLJzAJ7n-gnFtNqjMxljg/edit?usp=drive_web&tab=t.8oiur0bxvp23) 

  
  

### **Summary**

Competitive analysis covered marketing attribution and offer restructuring for property bookings.  
  
**Competitor Analysis and Attribution**  
Competitor models highlighted client lack of marketing knowledge and attribution tracking challenges.  
  
**Technical Tracking and Testing**  
Custom scripts and plugins improved event match quality scores for property management systems.

  
  

### **Decisions**

## **Aligned**

  - **Deployment of custom attribution tracking scripts** The team agreed to deploy custom scripts and plugins on booking engines and landing pages to capture click IDs and improve event match quality across Cloudbeds properties.

  
  

### **Next steps**

  - \[Leshan, Shawal\] Sync attribution testing: Meet to discuss the deployment and testing of improved meta ad attribution for clients such as Asheville and Northstar.
  - \[Leshan\] Implement attribution method: Apply the custom plugin and script attribution solution across all supported Property Management Systems.
  - \[Leshan\] Request API access: Inquire about API access for Property Management Systems such as Logify to enable integration with Hinge AI.

  
  

### **Details**

**Competitive Analysis of Sojurnn and Marketing Attribution Challenges**: Dustin Baker discusses the business model of Sojurnn, a major marketing company in the hotel and resort industry, noting that they operate as a software-as-a-service company connecting WordPress websites to booking engines and charging an 18% commission on completed stays ([00:00:10](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IDTNY2oBzIjvFxP9T_oKb_YLJzAJ7n-gnFtNqjMxljg/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.x9tgcruk5it9)). Dustin Baker highlights that while Sojurnn drives direct bookings, their clients do not experience brand growth, such as increased Instagram followers or email signups ([00:03:48](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IDTNY2oBzIjvFxP9T_oKb_YLJzAJ7n-gnFtNqjMxljg/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.fe1u4ft44s3z)). Dustin Baker points out that Sojurnn's clients, largely real estate investors, lack marketing knowledge and do not understand tracking or attribution, meaning they cannot determine whether Sojurnn actually generated bookings or if they would have occurred organically ([00:05:08](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IDTNY2oBzIjvFxP9T_oKb_YLJzAJ7n-gnFtNqjMxljg/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.4eymajs1bjdo)).

-----

**Potential Offer Restructuring and Attribution Thresholds**: Dustin Baker proposes enhancing their company's offer by guaranteeing double the direct bookings relative to the client's fee or refunding upfront costs after three months to make the service a compelling proposition ([00:09:26](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IDTNY2oBzIjvFxP9T_oKb_YLJzAJ7n-gnFtNqjMxljg/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.e0akb0drx0el)). Dustin Baker acknowledges that higher stakes will lead clients to question attribution accuracy against seasonality or past guest bookings ([00:11:28](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IDTNY2oBzIjvFxP9T_oKb_YLJzAJ7n-gnFtNqjMxljg/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.6bbx1sqsdich)). Dustin Baker argues that slight over-attribution is acceptable as long as clients achieve high direct booking volumes, noting that top competitors like Sojurnn utilize extended attribution windows (such as 28 days) without facing client pushback ([00:13:22](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IDTNY2oBzIjvFxP9T_oKb_YLJzAJ7n-gnFtNqjMxljg/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.2dlo37ezoiw)).

-----

**Core Meta Advertising Campaign Strategy**: Dustin Baker outlines four specific Meta ad campaigns to execute for all new clients moving forward: giveaway ads, retargeting engagers lead ads, retargeting website visitors purchase ads, and lookalike cold purchase campaigns ([00:19:48](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IDTNY2oBzIjvFxP9T_oKb_YLJzAJ7n-gnFtNqjMxljg/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.qxccurqmghgk)). Dustin Baker explains that improving attribution confidence will allow them to alter front-end sales pitches, potentially removing upfront costs and tying fees directly to performance metrics like cost per booking ([00:23:00](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IDTNY2oBzIjvFxP9T_oKb_YLJzAJ7n-gnFtNqjMxljg/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.djbz5ixsp3vz)).

-----

**Technical Implementation for Event Match Quality Improvement**: Leshan Patterson presents a technical solution to improve Event Match Quality and tracking across property management systems, sharing their screen to demonstrate the workflow ([00:28:32](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IDTNY2oBzIjvFxP9T_oKb_YLJzAJ7n-gnFtNqjMxljg/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.ugipq8oaa6l7)). Leshan Patterson details the addition of a custom script to the booking engine and custom plugins on websites and landing pages to capture Facebook click IDs, browser IDs, and reservation details, transmitting reservation notes back to Henge AI to deduplicate events and achieve an Event Match Quality score between 7 and 9 out of 10 ([00:31:34](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IDTNY2oBzIjvFxP9T_oKb_YLJzAJ7n-gnFtNqjMxljg/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.cmhz4jnj5vqi)).

-----

**Testing Attribution and Platform Compatibility Across Properties**: Dustin Baker and Leshan Patterson discuss testing the new attribution methods on specific properties utilizing Cloudbeds, including Asheville River Cabins, Northstar, and Glass Homes ([00:34:25](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IDTNY2oBzIjvFxP9T_oKb_YLJzAJ7n-gnFtNqjMxljg/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.fjg37c767873)) ([00:37:40](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IDTNY2oBzIjvFxP9T_oKb_YLJzAJ7n-gnFtNqjMxljg/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.chw2e8vcce7r)). Dustin Baker notes that higher Event Match Quality leads to more stable Meta ad optimization and consistent costs per booking, while Leshan Patterson notes that platforms like Logify may lack necessary API access compared to prominent property management systems like Hostaway, Guestie, Cloudbeds, and Muse ([00:36:36](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IDTNY2oBzIjvFxP9T_oKb_YLJzAJ7n-gnFtNqjMxljg/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.32rm2govkmh4)).

-----

**Exploring Future Booking Flow Modifications and Onboarding Friction**: Dustin Baker questions whether altering marketing touchpoints, such as adding a bottom-of-funnel listings page or changing data collection requirements, could further improve tracking ([00:39:49](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IDTNY2oBzIjvFxP9T_oKb_YLJzAJ7n-gnFtNqjMxljg/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.kfyxeycfuymk)). Leshan Patterson explains that the current approach was chosen to minimize barriers to entry, utilizing existing infrastructure with minimal setup time rather than building complex V3 landing pages from scratch ([00:41:09](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IDTNY2oBzIjvFxP9T_oKb_YLJzAJ7n-gnFtNqjMxljg/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.bnile7qidmvz)). Dustin Baker discusses reducing onboarding friction to potentially adopt a zero-upfront-cost, performance-based model inspired by Sojurnn to massively scale client acquisition ([00:42:32](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IDTNY2oBzIjvFxP9T_oKb_YLJzAJ7n-gnFtNqjMxljg/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.fbiapzojm0d5)).
